content.short: Mint your NFT for free without having technical expertise.
content.description:
You can mint your NFT for free on Kardano Club . Our goal is to make it easy and smooth for people to mint their NFTs without having technical knowledge. The process consists of 3 steps only.

Simply click on Start and just follow the instructions. This is just the first version and, improvements are on the way as we believe there is a huge potential in Cardano in the NFT world.

We're also planning to open source the library (JS based) we've developed and used to interact with Cardano CLI. This should be useful for developers. Feedback is very welcome!
